name: Stakpak
description_en:
Stakpak is a product in the AI coding category. Its directory profile covers Natural Language to Code, Documentation Assitance, IDE Integration, Context-Aware Code, AI Copilot, Security and Privacy Compliance, Multi Programming Languages, Code Completion.

Additional listed capabilities include Collaboration Tools. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $50.0. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: suggest code while it is being written; support shared work and communication between participants. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
